items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: And we played for Jo Stafford and Ethel Merman, who was pregnant.

ctx.x: Oh my. I didn’t know that.

But anyway I had passed everything with the Air Cadets so they said, “what do you want to be, a bombardier or a navigator or a pilot?” I said, “no, I want to be a musician.” “We don’t have any musicians in the Air Cadets.” “Oh really? Put me back in the Army.” So they put me back in the Army. They said forget all that. So then they started Special Service at that point, so I was shipped down to Alabama. Camp Sibert. And people like Mickey Rooney and Joe Lewis were down there and all musicians and actors and stuff…
